message:
The other night, we had an unexpected power outage. I was sitting there in the dark, thinking it was going to be a long evening. But then I remembered my trusty power bank tucked away in a drawer! I charged up my phone just enough to keep the flashlight app running and even played some soothing music to lighten the mood. 

We ended up having a little family game night by flashlight, and it turned into a really sweet memory. Sometimes, it’s the small wins that can save the day! ✨ 

What’s your go-to tip for handling a power outage?
